# 爱马仕Agent 知识图谱

## 系统整体结构概览
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    G1["Gateway"] --> A1["Agent Loop"]
    A1 --> T1["Tool Layer"]
    T1 --> SM["Skill Manager"]
    T1 --> SR["Smart Routing"]
    T1 --> SA["Security Approve"]
```
证据: [BV1f1DQBgEZh P1 01:08]、[BV1f1DQBgEZh P1 01:16]、[BV1f1DQBgEZh P1 01:22]、[BV1f1DQBgEZh P1 01:49]、[BV1f1DQBgEZh P1 04:44]、[BV1f1DQBgEZh P1 06:26]

## 自我进化机制（Skill Manager）
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    SM["Skill Manager"] --> C1["Create / Edit / Patch"]
    C1 --> SC["Skill Content"]
    SC --> R1["Register to Toolset"]
    R1 --> UP["Update on Error"]
    UP --> CP["User Confirmation"]
```
证据: [BV1f1DQBgEZh P1 01:49]、[BV1f1DQBgEZh P1 02:11]、[BV1f1DQBgEZh P1 02:17]、[BV1f1DQBgEZh P1 02:57]、[BV1f1DQBgEZh P1 03:40]、[BV1f1DQBgEZh P1 04:05]

## 智能路由模型选择
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    MSG["User Message"] --> RULE["Routing Rules"]
    RULE --> LONG["Length > 160"]
    RULE --> NL["Many Newlines"]
    RULE --> CODE["Contains Code Block"]
    RULE --> URL["Contains URL"]
    LONG --> COMPLEX["Complex Model (Anthropic)"]
    NL --> COMPLEX
    CODE --> COMPLEX
    URL --> COMPLEX
    RULE --> CHEAP["Cheap Model"]
```
证据: [BV1f1DQBgEZh P1 05:10]、[BV1f1DQBgEZh P1 05:16]、[BV1f1DQBgEZh P1 05:21]、[BV1f1DQBgEZh P1 05:23]、[BV1f1DQBgEZh P1 05:34]、[BV1f1DQBgEZh P1 06:05]

## 工具安全执行审批
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    TOOL["Tool Execution"] --> APPROVE["Approve Check"]
    APPROVE --> KEY["Keyword Matching"]
    KEY --> RISK["Risky Keywords"]
    RISK --> HUMAN["Human Confirmation"]
    HUMAN --> EXEC["Execute"]
    KEY --> EXEC
    RISK --> BLOCK["Block Execution"]
```
证据: [BV1f1DQBgEZh P1 06:26]、[BV1f1DQBgEZh P1 06:32]、[BV1f1DQBgEZh P1 06:35]、[BV1f1DQBgEZh P1 06:42]
